meta.title: Prazos — No deadline slips by

ui.shareText: Prazos — No deadline slips by. My Social Security and tax deadline calendar in 4 questions:

ssDecl: Declare your income for {q} {y} in Segurança Social Direta.
fine of €50–250 and SS sets the minimum €20 contribution. You can still file late until {late}.
ssDeclJan: Declare {q} {y} and confirm your annual income for {y}.
fine of €50–250; late filing possible until {late}.
ssLate: If you missed the {m} declaration, file it marked “Fora de Prazo”.
after this date the window closes until the next declaration.
ssPay: Pay between the 10th and the 20th. Amount in Segurança Social Direta.
late interest; after 30 days a serious offence (€300–1,200).
ssTop: If January’s confirmation produced an amount due, pay by this date.
ssStart: From today you contribute to Social Security.
efat: Assign your {y} invoices to the activity on Portal das Finanças.
missing expenses up to the 15% are added to taxable income.
irsDecl: File Modelo 3 with Anexo B (and the annual Anexo SS) between 1 April and 30 June.
fine under RGIT. This deadline does not move to the next working day.
irsPay: If the assessment shows tax due, pay by this date.
ppc: Only if AT sends you the document (about a month ahead). Under €50 is not paid.
ivaAlt: Income above €15,000 → VAT from 1 January. File the declaração de alterações.
VAT due from the moment the threshold was crossed.
ivaNow: Over €18,750 this year: VAT from that moment; change declaration within 15 working days (indicative date).

r101b: While income stays under €15,000, write on the recibo: {m}. Without it, the company withholds 23%.
rOver: Above €15,000 the exemption ends the following month.
rFirst: Contribution exemption until {d}. Check in Segurança Social Direta whether quarterly declarations are waived.
rRecap: After the 2025 changes the rule is ambiguous for the art. 53 regime. Confirm with an accountant or AT.
rInv: Fatura-recibo on the day of payment; fatura by the 5th working day; EU services by the 15th of the next month. Advances included.
rIns: Mandatory while the activity is open.
rChg: Changes: 15 days. Closing the activity: 30 days.

flyer.h1: The calendar that lets no deadline slip
flyer.lead: Social Security and the Tax Authority don’t send reminders. A forgotten declaration turns into a minimum contribution, a fine and interest — and you find out months later. Prazos shows your whole year in four questions.
how: Start of activity, clients, expected income, last IRS.
Each date with what to do, what happens if you miss it and the legal basis.
One tap and the whole year is on your phone: an alert when each window opens and on the last day.
what: Missed a declaration? Prazos shows until when you can still file it late.
Deadline on a Saturday? It reminds you on Friday. The 30 June IRS deadline doesn’t move — and Prazos says so.
Every date checked against the CRC, the SS Practical Guide, CIRS and CIVA. No source, no date.

clara.name: Clara
clara.h1: Clara, the voice of your deadlines
clara.camOn: Watching for a nod · video stays on the phone
clara.none: All clear. I'll tell you when the next window opens.
clara.future: Today “yes” marks it done. With IP Contour, “yes” = file and pay.

say.last: {what}. Today is the last day. {where}. {amount}. Is it done?
say.hello: Hi, I'm Clara. I'll remind you of your deadlines.
say.later: All right. I'll remind you tomorrow.

amount.ge50: Only if it's fifty euros or more
amount.calc: The amount is in the notice

say.first: This is the very first one.
say.end: That's all for now. Say “start over” to go through again.
say.help: You can say: yes, later, next, back, repeat, start over, how much, where, when, or stop.
say.unknown: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Say “yes”, “later” or “help”.
say.bye: All right, I'll be quiet. Tap the orb when you want to go on.

clara.paused: Paused. Tap the orb to carry on.
